data.narrative:
Emerald AI is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Varun Sivaram that has raised $68M to date. The comparable universe for Climate & Energy includes one public company (LNZA) and eight private peers, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with similar valuation tiers to support a reliable peer-median approach—zero datapoints met the narrow filtering criteria.

Given data constraints, stage-progression analysis is the applicable triangulation method. Using total raised ($68M) as a value proxy and applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier yields an implied valuation of $170M. This method reflects expected dilution and capital efficiency benchmarks for frontier-tech companies advancing from Seed funding.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $144M to $195M, with a median of $170M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single methodological lens; the primary uncertainty stems from the absence of tight peer comparables in Climate & Energy at Emerald AI's stage. Validation would benefit from (1) identification of additional same-stage private comparables, (2) revenue or unit-economics data to support earnings multiples, or (3) time-to-revenue assumptions that could anchor an alternative DCF approach.
